validity.researcher_notes: This is a REAL, correctly-classified project, not a GEM-only entity or a duplicate of anything else in the 43-row Guangxi roster (no other row shares its length/diameter/endpoints). Found the row's own official approval decree still live: Guangxi Development & Reform Commission document 桂发改油气〔2019〕1136号, '广西壮族自治区发展和改革委员会关于广西天然气支线管网项目河池-南丹天然气支线管道工程项目核准的批复' (approval of the Hechi-Nandan gas branch pipeline project), dated 2019-12-03. Confirmed via TWO independent access paths to the SAME underlying document: (1) an archive.org screenshot cited by the wiki page (https://archive.org/details/2023-09-30-211609), which I downloaded and read directly (it is an image, not text -- url_verifier necessarily FAILs a screenshot's substring check, so I visually confirmed the Chinese text myself); (2) the issuing agency's own gxzf.gov.cn page, live via Wayback (found through search, not the wiki page), which I fetched with curl and decoded as UTF-8 by hand -- url_verifier also FAILed this one on an encoding false-negative (requests auto-detected the wrong charset and mangled the CJK text), but my own UTF-8 decode shows the identical paragraph verbatim, including '113.56km' and '河池...南丹'. Document body: project unit 广西广投天然气管网有限公司 (project route: 河池市境内, 途径金城江、宜州、南丹县(区) -- i.e. Hechi city, via Jinchengjiang, Yizhou, to Nandan county, matching the segment's Hechi->Nandan framing); ~113.56km new pipeline (EXACT match to GEM's LengthKnown=113.56); new Nandan distribution station + 4 valve chambers; design throughput 5.15亿m3/年 = 0.515 bcm/y (GEM records Capacity=0.52 bcm/y -- ~1% rounding difference, not material); design pressure 4.0MPa; diameters DN300 (Hechi station-Nandan station) and DN250 (Nandan station-downstream gas gate station) (EXACT match to GEM's Diameter='300/250' mm); total investment ~41,346万元 = RMB 413,460,000.00 (EXACT match to GEM's SegmentCost). A THIRD wiki-cited screenshot (https://archive.org/details/2023-09-30-212740) is the cover page of this same project's EIA report ('河池-南丹天然气支线管道工程环境影响报告书'), which names the construction unit as 广西燃气集团有限公司 (Guangxi Gas Group) rather than 广西广投天然气管网有限公司 -- likely an upstream parent/predecessor entity in the corporate structure (Guangxi's gas-network assets have been reorganized more than once during PipeChina's provincial-network consolidation); noting as a caveat, not a contradiction, since the approval decree (the more specific, later-stage document) names the same operator GEM already records. StartYear1=2022/StartMonth1=9 and Status=operating are independently corroborated by a separate, different-origin source -- see status_reviews. Two open caveats: (1) I could not independently confirm the exact village-level endpoints (Podi Village/Dongjiang Town and Weiyong Village/Nandan County) beyond the county/prefecture-level route the approval decree gives; (2) the existing Status [ref] cell already holds a live, correct citation (archive.org/details/2023-09-30-212529) that url_verifier's existing_ref_checks flagged as failing 'operating' -- that is a false negative from the same image-vs-text problem, not evidence the ref is wrong; I viewed the underlying screenshot myself and it fully supports 'operating' (see status_reviews).

validity.researcher_notes: GEM's FuelSource for this row is 'Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network Hechi Branch' -- i.e. the pipeline's own name/segment, not an upstream gas field or plant. docs/reference/gem_schema.md's own gotcha section says exactly this pattern is wrong ('FuelSource...is not the commodity/fuel type...When researching FuelSource, find the named origin field/facility; if you can't attribute one, leave it blank and note why -- do not default it'). None of the three sources I read for this row (2019 approval decree, 2022 news article, EIA cover page) name a specific upstream field/plant/import terminal feeding the Hechi-Nandan branch specifically -- the broader Guangxi provincial network draws on a mix of West-East Gas Pipeline Line 2 supply and Beihai LNG imports, but attributing one specific source to this one branch without a document that actually says so would be a fabrication. Leaving FuelSource unresolved (blank) is the correct move per the schema's own instruction, rather than keeping the current self-referential value.

Confirmed the SAME decree from two origins (an archive.org screenshot and the issuing agency's own gxzf.gov.cn page via Wayback); both FAIL url_verifier's automated screen (image content / encoding auto-detect mangling CJK respectively) -- I manually decoded/read both and they are identical and match.

Decree: '管径分别为DN300(河池分输站-南丹分输站)和DN250(南丹分输站-下游燃气门站)' -- exact match to GEM's dual-diameter '300/250'. Same two-origin confirmation as Capacity above.
Decree: '本项目总投资约41346万元' = RMB 413,460,000 -- exact match. Same two-origin confirmation as Capacity above. Decree does not state a cost year; leaving SegmentCostYear untouched.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The sheet's own current_ref for Status (archive.org/details/2023-09-30-212529) is a screenshot of 河池日报 (Hechi Daily), 2022-09-14: '大任产业园管输天然气正式通气' -- on 2022-09-13 the Hechi-Nandan gas branch pipeline's Da Ren section held its official gas-connection ceremony (explicitly named as this project by segment name). This directly supports Status=operating; the sheet's automated existing_ref_checks flagged this ref as failing (200 but 'operating' not found as a substring) purely because the citation is an archive.org screenshot IMAGE, not extractable text -- I downloaded and read the image myself and it fully supports the status. I also found a separate 2023-12-05 industry article (shpgx.com) describing the operator (广投管网/Guangtou Pipeline Network Co) as having achieved gas connectivity to 11 cities including 河池/Hechi, consistent with continued operation well past the 2022 commissioning. No evidence of the line being shut down, reversed, or reclassified. Searched for a full-line completion/acceptance notice beyond the 15.5km Da Ren section but found none newer than the 2022 commissioning; that does not indicate dormancy -- the project's own 2019 approval decree, 2022 partial-commissioning news, and 2023 network-coverage description form a consistent, still-current picture. No dormancy rule applies (status is operating, not proposed/shelved).

summary: P6042 (Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network, Hechi-Nandan Branch Pipeline) is real and correctly classified -- confirmed via a live 2019 Guangxi gov approval decree (two independent access paths) that exact-matches GEM's length/diameter/cost and near-matches capacity, plus a separate 2022 news article confirming operating status and StartYear1/Month1=2022/9; filled 9 missing refs (Fuel, PipelineType, Start, Capacity, Length, Diameter, SegmentCost, Operator, Owner), left Location at low-confidence district-level only, and flagged FuelSource as an attribution concern (current value self-referentially repeats the pipeline's own name rather than naming an upstream source, per the schema's own gotcha) -- UNRESOLVED, recommend blanking it.
